semantic_constraints.series: a tax series is keyed by dataset, indicator, jurisdiction (ISO 3166 alpha-3), CbCR partner grouping, unit with its multiplier, annual frequency and nature (published_statistic or model_estimate); the edition is never part of the key; published statistics also live in the Economics series storage (economic_vintages, dataset_observations)
semantic_constraints.editions: each edition (an OECD Corporate Tax Statistics edition, an Atlas of the Offshore World update, a Global Tax Evasion Report) is a release vintage dated by its declared publication date; a changed value is a new vintage, never an overwrite; a series a complete later edition no longer states gets a removed_by_source vintage; as-of answers select the edition published by the date and cite source, edition, record revision and as-of time
semantic_constraints.estimates: model estimates (OECD forward-looking effective tax rates, EU Tax Observatory offshore wealth and billionaire effective tax rates) keep their method and edition, have status estimated, are answered in a separate section from published statistics, are never written to the Economics observation storage and are never presented as observations
semantic_constraints.status: OBS_STATUS and CONF_STATUS letters are kept verbatim per value; a confidential cell is a status and carries no value
semantic_constraints.identity: public CbCR references reach ownership entities only through reviewed identity decisions (published identifiers first, names as low evidence); nothing is auto-merged, decisions are revertible and unmatched references stay visible
semantic_constraints.sources: OECD and EU Tax Observatory sources are unverified-live until a dated live run (EU Tax Observatory licence not established); Tax Justice Network indices are not-implemented (licence) and reported as such, never as an empty answer; public CbCR reports under Directive (EU) 2021/2101 are reference-only
semantic_constraints.minimisation: published aggregates and estimates per jurisdiction only; public CbCR references are link-only and never carry a figure; person-, taxpayer- and wealth-holder-level fields are refused at write time
semantic_constraints.exclusions: no own effective tax rate, profit-shifting or tax-gap estimate, no ratio, share, per-capita or per-employee figure, no blending of sources, no model estimate presented as an observation, no ranking or risk score, no filled jurisdiction or year, no currency conversion, no forecasts
